meta.source: https://www.valentirtech.com/ — computed styles from the production site (Next.js + MUI), plus the official logo files, 2026-10-09

tokens.name: green-900
tokens.usage: Primary brand green. Fill of primary buttons (Talk to a Fleet Expert, Calculate your ROI, Accept), action-link text (Learn more →, Explore solution →), industry icon ink and the footer’s 3px top rule. `ink-inverse` text on it: 11.1:1.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Hero action green: fill of the main CTA over the photo (Contact an expert), border of outlined buttons (View all products) and the logo’s 2px focus outline. `ink-inverse` text on it: 6.4:1.

tokens.name: green-50
tokens.usage: Background tint of the 44px icon tile (`radius-lg`) in industry cards. Fill only; icons sit on it in `green-900` (9.9:1).

tokens.name: teal-600
tokens.usage: Signal accent: hero eyebrow (VALENTIR GREEN TECH) on dark, testimonial quote marks, the newsletter’s 3px top rule and the 3px focus ring. On `surface-inverse` 4.8:1; on `surface` only 3.7:1 — not for text under 24px on light backgrounds.

tokens.name: rust-700
tokens.usage: Warm accent (MUI warning color): only the newsletter Subscribe button. `ink-inverse` text on it: 6.0:1. Once per view.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Ink of the Inter text logo “Valentir / Green Tech” as the live site’s header sets it today. Differs from the official lockups (`logo-ink` / `logo-slate`): use the logo files for new work.

tokens.name: logo-teal
tokens.usage: Shutter teal of the mark, measured on the official horizontal logo. Brand pieces and the cover only; in UI use `teal-600` or `green-700`.

tokens.name: logo-orange
tokens.usage: Center orange dot of the mark, measured on the official logo. Brand pieces only; never an interface color.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: Ink of the word “Valentir” in the official lockups (near-black blue). On `surface`: 16.9:1. Brand pieces only.

tokens.name: logo-slate
tokens.usage: Ink of “Green Tech”, the rule and the tagline in the official lockups. On `surface`: 6.1:1. Brand pieces only.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background (public-shell) and fill of soft buttons (B.C. dashcam compliance, Solution finder).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Header, cards (product, industry, resources), cookie banner and form fields.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark bands: testimonial, newsletter panel, footer, and image placeholder while loading.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Densest stop of the hero scrim (90° gradient 0.84 → 0.68 → 0.22 → 0 over the photo) so the white headline reads over the image.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: section headlines, card titles and body on `surface` (15.4:1) and `surface-page` (14.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: card subtitles, section intros and field labels on `surface` (7.6:1) and `surface-page` (7.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`, `green-900`, `green-700`, `rust-700` and over the hero scrim.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-inverse` (the site’s 0.85 opacity): newsletter description, testimonial context. Footer links use 0.9.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-tertiary
tokens.usage: Footer legal text (© 2026 Valentir Green Tech…) on `surface-inverse` (8.1:1).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: 1px border of cards and the header’s bottom line.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: 1px border of resting outlined text fields.

tokens.name: outline-inverse
tokens.usage: 1px border of the secondary button over the hero photo (Solution finder).

tokens.name: header-scrolled
tokens.usage: Sticky header fill once the page scrolls, with backdrop-filter: blur(10px).

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Hero H1 in `ink-inverse` over the scrimmed photo. Once per page.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Fleet video, tracking, and protection for owner-operators and growing carriers.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: The equipment is bringing a lot of benefits to our fleet.

styles.name: card-title-tight
styles.usage: Industry card titles (next to the icon tile).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Video, GPS, cargo integrity, and theft recovery.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card subtitles and short descriptions in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: body-sm-relaxed
styles.sample: Same-day visibility for owner-operators and small fleets.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footer links (0.9 opacity) and helper text.

styles.name: legal
styles.sample: © 2026 Valentir Green Tech. All rights reserved.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Standard buttons and arrow action links.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE eyebrow (text-transform: uppercase) in `teal-600` on dark.

styles.name: logo-name
styles.usage: First line of the site’s text logo, in `navy-800` (light) or `ink-inverse` (dark). Reference only; new work uses the logo files.

styles.name: logo-suffix
styles.usage: Second line of the site’s text logo, tracked 0.2em. Reference only.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of compact and nav buttons.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between mark and text logo; horizontal padding of menu items.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Header gap; horizontal padding of small buttons.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Product and resource card padding (16px 16px 24px); mobile gutter; horizontal padding of standard buttons.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card grid gap and industry card padding (20px 20px 24px).

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; newsletter panel and footer column padding.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Vertical page content padding; horizontal padding of the testimonial band.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5xl
tokens.usage: Top spacing before the newsletter block.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Logo focus area.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Large hero buttons and the mobile menu button.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Default radius: buttons, cards, fields, newsletter panel, cookie banner.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Industry card icon tile (44×44).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Social icon buttons (40×40).

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Contained buttons (primary, Subscribe, Accept).

tokens.name: elevation-8
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: cookie banner, dropdown menus.

tokens.name: header-scrolled-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow line of the sticky header after scrolling.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width (public-page-gutter).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header minimum height from 600px; 56px on mobile.

tokens.name: header-height-mobile
tokens.usage: Header minimum height below 600px.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: Industry card icon tile and minimum button touch target.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Height of outlined text fields (padding 16.5px 14px).

tokens.name: product-image-height
tokens.usage: Image height in product cards (object-fit: cover).
